title: Companion
description: One entry in data/engine/companions.json: a person who can join the player's party, how they fight, the perk they grant while with the player and what makes them refuse.

loadout.description: The NPC and the weapon and armor the companion fights with. The wiki gives no loadouts, so these are placeholders. A `when` is not allowed: a companion is in a fight because they are in the party.

perk.description: A perk whose modifiers the player has while the companion is in the party.

refuses_when.description: The companion will not join, and leaves, while any of these holds.
